description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InterviewPreference" name="Candidate provides interview preference">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Choose interview format by candidate preference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormatMerge" name="Continue after interview">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Continue after salary negotiation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Orientation" name="Complete orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Event_InterviewPreference"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Virtual preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidatePreference = "virtual"</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation"/>
